title: Hand of Straights
description: Determine if cards can be partitioned into groups of consecutive integers of size groupSize.
pseudocode:
1. Sort the hand array.
2. Count occurrences of each card in a frequency map.
3. Iterate through sorted unique cards.
4. For each card, if count > 0, try to form a group of size groupSize.
5. Decrement counts for each consecutive card; return false if a card is missing.

steps.note: Start group 1: Found 1, decrement counts. Next 2, 3.
Start group 2: Found 2, decrement counts. Next 3, 4.
Start group 3: Found 6, decrement counts. Next 7, 8.
All groups successfully formed. Return true.
